parse.text:
Psyshkhwe Arietta

Char­ac­ter

Vodyanitsa

Talent Type

Normal Attack

Category

Combat
  • Info
Normal Attack
Sings an ancient song of the Water Imps, unleashing up to 4 strikes. This deals Hydro DMG to the opponent.

Charged Attack
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to hurl a water ball forward, dealing Hydro DMG.

Plunging Attack
Plunges towards the ground from mid-air, damaging all opponents along the path. Deals AoE Hydro DMG upon impact with the ground.
Psyshkhwe Arietta is Vodyanitsa's Normal Attack.

Trivia[]

Etymology[]

  • Psyshkhwe (Adyghe: Псышхъуэ) is Adyghe ,псы [psə] " water " + шхъуэ [ʃχʷə]（or щхъуэ in Kabardian）" grey–blue–green ".The literal internal form is "water's grey‑blue" or "the blue‑green hue of water".
  • This interpretation corresponds to its Chinese rendering.
